title: Utri hain aaj fatima zehra zameen par
body:
Ya Zahra Ya Zahra Ya Zahra Ya Zahra
Utri Hai Aj Fatima Zehra Zameen Per
Kaisay Rahai Dimagh Zami'n Ka Zameen Per
Jibreel Kis Se Poch Ke Layega Ayatain
<<DIVIDER>>
Zahra Yahin Hain Tu Bhi Thehar Jaa Zameen Per
Khud Ake Degi Mout Suna Ran Ko Zindagi
Han Zahra Bicha Rahi Hai Musalla Zameen Per
Wo Jaa Rahi Hai Arsh Pe Zahra Ki Rotiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo Aa Raha Hai Dehar Ka Surah Zameen Per
Zahra Ne Khud Dua Ko Uthaye Hain Apne Hath
Haan Abbas Tum Ko Ana Parega Zameen Per
Haan Jannat Se Karbala Ka Pata Puchti Hui
<<DIVIDER>>
Adam Ke Sath Ai Hai Hawa Zameen Per
Bekar Hai Yeh Isko Jahannum Mai Bhej Do
Aray Ik Bhoj Hai Yeh Dushman e Zehra Zameen Per
Hota Hai Asmaan Pe Tilawat Mai Wo Shumar
<<DIVIDER>>
Parhiye Jo Syeda Ka Qasida Zameen Per
Taqseem Karti Fatima Zahra Ager Fidak
Baqi Na Rehta Koi Bhi Bhuka Zameen Per
Yeh Bhi To Mustafa Hai Taqallum Isi Liye
<<DIVIDER>>
Milta Nahi Batool Ka Saaya Zameen Per
author: Mir Hassan Mir
